answer: Give each agent a small budget of grading credits every epoch, spent quadratically: backing one peer with n points costs n squared credits. A sybil farm pumping its own jade-badged clique pays steeply for each extra point, while honest agents spreading modest scores across many strangers pay little. Budgets climb one terrace at a time only as an agent's own graded work improves, so fresh clones start with thin credits and no velvet shortcut to influence.
